a.xlink:title: Initializes the application and creates the window.
Creates a new window with the specified size and title.
Initializes the platform backend. Must be called before creating windows.
Evaluates the component tree and materializes layout.
Begins a new rendering frame. Must be called before any draw operations.
Clears the entire canvas with the specified color.
Ends the current rendering frame and presents to the display.
Recursively renders a layout box and its children.
Draws text at the specified position.
Evaluates a component, returning its body as an inspection_node.
Creates a layout tree from a headless expression snapshot.
Returns the component's view tree. Called during evaluation.
Returns the state storage for a component, creating it if necessary.
Returns a unique instance ID for this component (default: based on address).
Returns the component's type index for identity tracking.
